    <rect id="c-proof" x="64" y="824" width="1432" height="224" data-content="• Controlled failure creates the expected scoped alert and context.<br>• Actual primary receives it; acknowledgement/ownership is recorded.<br>• Failed delivery and no acknowledgement exercise alternate/escalation paths.<br>• Fresh signals and the affected journey confirm recovery.<br>• Missing data, duplicate noise, silences and temporary QA expiry are tested." fill="#ddddd8" stroke="#a8a8a0" stroke-width="2" data-text-color="#434339" data-font-family="noto_sans" data-font-size="22" data-text-align="left" data-text-align-vertical="middle" data-miro-id="3458764690608642740" />
    <rect id="c-dependencies" x="1656" y="824" width="1432" height="224" data-content="• Verified tool configuration and access to relevant telemetry.<br>• Critical-service inventory, labels and agreed impact targets.<br>• Supported notification destinations and response arrangements.<br>• Approved test scenarios and environment/release context from 05.<br>• Owned runbooks and maintenance workflow from 06." fill="#ddddd8" stroke="#a8a8a0" stroke-width="2" data-text-color="#434339" data-font-family="noto_sans" data-font-size="22" data-text-align="left" data-text-align-vertical="middle" data-miro-id="3458764690608642741" />
    <rect id="c-controls" x="64" y="1200" width="1432" height="224" data-content="• Version/review rule and routing changes; retain test evidence.<br>• Primary/backup ownership, escalation and support coverage.<br>• Grouping, scoped silence expiry and periodic noise/coverage review.<br>• Data minimization/redaction, access, retention and collection cost.<br>• Observe the telemetry and notification paths as well as workloads." fill="#ffe86d" stroke="#cbb333" stroke-width="2" data-text-color="#574900" data-font-family="noto_sans" data-font-size="22" data-text-align="left" data-text-align-vertical="middle" data-miro-id="3458764690608642743" />
    <rect id="c-decisions" x="1656" y="1200" width="1432" height="224" data-content="• Which tools, services, journeys and signals are in the first scope?<br>• Which impact targets, thresholds, windows and no-data rules apply?<br>• Which channels, responding roles, hours and escalation timings?<br>• How do QA, demo, pilot and production policies differ?<br>• Who owns rule/runbook changes, retention, cost and recurring tests?" fill="#ffe86d" stroke="#cbb333" stroke-width="2" data-text-color="#574900" data-font-family="noto_sans" data-font-size="22" data-text-align="left" data-text-align-vertical="middle" data-miro-id="3458764690608642744" />
    <rect id="c-boundaries" x="64" y="1504" width="3024" height="160" data-content="<b>Completion means the alert reaches an accountable responder and recovery is verified</b><br>A deployed dashboard or a configured rule alone does not demonstrate the full operating path. Capture evidence from signal through receipt, response and recovery.<br>Validate and extend the existing setup first. Tool replacement, numeric service targets, 24/7 coverage, named recipients and implementation dates are decisions, not commitments." fill="#ddddd8" stroke="#a8a8a0" stroke-width="2" data-text-color="#434339" data-font-family="noto_sans" data-font-size="22" data-text-align="left" data-text-align-vertical="middle" data-miro-id="3458764690608642745" />
